messages:
nina: Quick announce: docs refresh + SDK v2.5 release notes are live. This release focuses on typings, Go parity, and a small breaking change for embeddings batching. Please review.
travis: Breaking change details?
meera: Embeddings: default batch window changed from 200ms to 50ms to reduce latency for small requests. That can increase compute for huge batchers. We added a config `embeddings.batch_window_ms` to opt back in.
lex: We should call out customers running large offline embedding jobs. Might need a migration note for cost impact.
nina: Agreed. Docs now include a "batching cost" section with example cost math and codemod to change client config.
meera: Also released stronger TypeScript types for new streaming shapes and added Go examples for every quickstart.
travis: Any auth or header changes?
meera: No header changes this time. Small renames: SDK helper `client.embedMany()` -> `client.createEmbeddingsBatch()` to clarify semantics.
lex: Can we get a short snippet for old vs new embed call?
nina: Old:
```
await client.embedMany(texts)
```
New:
```
await client.createEmbeddingsBatch({ inputs: texts, batch_window_ms: 50 })
```
travis: Docs-bot: link to migration guide?
docs-bot: Migration doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdks/v2-5-migration includes batch tuning guide, TypeScript FAQ, and Go parity notes. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/420
lex: Timeline: announcement today, advisory banners next week, SDK npm/pypi tagged release now, soft warnings in 14 days, breaking behavior default enforced in 60 days (but config stays available).
meera: SRE: please watch embeddings-cost-per-token and embedding-job-duration during rollout.
nina: Customer comms: product will email orgs with >1TB embedding usage last 90d. Anna will craft copy.
travis: I'll add a small note in the Console release picker about v2.5 typings.
meera: Thanks team. If any example gaps (Ruby/Go) ping me and I'll add them.
__notes: Simulated Slack thread: docs + SDK v2.5 release focusing on typings, Go parity, and embeddings batching change. No title field per agents.md.
